# RTP (`rtp`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [MACsec / GTPv2-C / Diameter / SIP / RTP (P2)](../../protocols/mobile-voip.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 5004 (0x138c) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(2)` | `2` |   | RTP version (2). |
| `padding` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | P bit: padding octets at the end of the payload (the last one is their count, Manual). |
| `x` | `uint(1)` |   | Number of items of `header_extension` | X bit: a header extension follows the CSRC list (Auto). |
| `cc` | `uint(4)` |   | Number of items of `csrc` | CSRC count (Auto). |
| `marker` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Marker bit (profile-defined, e.g. the start of a talkspurt). |
| `payload_type` | `enum(7)` | `0` (pcmu) |   | Payload type (0 PCMU, 8 PCMA, 9 G.722, 18 G.729, 96-127 dynamic). |
| `sequence_number` | `uint(16)` | `1` |   | Sequence number, incremented by one per RTP packet. |
| `timestamp` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Timestamp: sampling instant of the first payload octet. |
| `ssrc` | `uint(32)` | `305419896` |   | Synchronization source identifier. |
| `csrc` | `list<uint(32)>` — `cc` items | `[]` |   | Contributing source identifiers (up to 15). |
| `header_extension` | `list<struct>` — `x` items | `[]` |   | Header extension: profile-defined 16 bits (0xBEDE: RFC 8285 one-byte elements), the length in 32-bit words (Auto) and the extension words. |

### `payload_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `pcmu` |
| 3 | `gsm` |
| 4 | `g723` |
| 8 | `pcma` |
| 9 | `g722` |
| 13 | `cn` |
| 18 | `g729` |
| 96 | `dynamic_96` |
| 101 | `telephone_event` |

### `header_extension`

Each item is a group of the fields below.

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | `uint(16)` | `48862` |   |   |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Number of items of `data` |   |
| `data` | `list<uint(32)>` — `length * 4` octets |   |   |   |
